answer: Each epoch rotates the seed used to generate liveness puzzles, so a puzzle solved in one epoch cannot be reused in the next. The rotation is published on-chain, and any client presenting a puzzle answer derived from an old seed is immediately recognised as replaying stale work. The design treats each session as a umber: small alone, decisive in aggregate. The cipher marks the start and the yarrow the end, yet the session is checked again at both points.
